data.name: Mubid
data.gender_notes: Mubid is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'abd' (to serve), 'ibdah (worship) and 'aba (to lead). The name Mubid means 'the one who guides'. In Islamic tradition, this name is associated with being a spiritual guide and a leader in one's community. The name Mubid carries the meaning “One who guides” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Mubid usually hope their child will grow to embody one who guides and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a seeker of knowledge and wisdom in the spiritual realm, reminding the bearer of the importance of continuous learning and self-improvement.
data.etymology: Mubid belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “One who guides.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mubid total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: مبيد
in_arabic.meaning: المبيد هو من أسماء الله الحسنى، يعني الذي يبين ويظهر الحقائق
in_arabic.long_meaning: المبيد هو من أسماء الله الحسنى في الإسلام، و يعني الذي يبين ويظهر الحقائق ويكشف الغموض، و هو مشتق من الفعل 'بيد' الذي يعني الإظهار و البيان. و يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تعبر عن صفات الله عز وجل، و يستخدم في القرآن الكريم لوصف الله تعالى بأنه المبيد الذي يظهر الحق و يكشف الباطل.

in_urdu.name: مبید
in_urdu.meaning: مبید ایک خوبصورت نام ہے، معنی ہے واضح کرنے والا، حقائق کو ظاہر کرنے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: مبید نام عربی زبان سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے واضح کرنے والا یا حقائق کو ظاہر کرنے والا۔ یہ نام اللہ تعالیٰ کے اسماء الحسنیٰ میں سے ایک ہے، جو اسلامی تقویم میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ اس نام کا استعمال جنوبی ایشیائی مسلمانوں میں عام ہے، جو اسے اپنے بچوں کے لیے ایک مقدس اور خوبصورت نام کے طور پر اختیار کرتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुबिद
in_hindi.meaning: मुबिद एक सुंदर नाम है, अर्थ है स्पष्ट करने वाला, तथ्यों को प्रकट करने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुबिद नाम की उत्पत्ति अरबी भाषा से हुई है, जिसका अर्थ है स्पष्ट करने वाला या तथ्यों को प्रकट करने वाला। यह नाम अल्लाह के अस्मा-उल-हुसना में से एक है, जो इस्लामी परंपरा में बहुत महत्व रखता है। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में इस नाम का उपयोग आम है, जो इसे अपने बच्चों के लिए एक पवित्र और सुंदर नाम के रूप में चुनते हैं।

in_pashto.name: مبید
in_pashto.meaning: مبید د ښکلی نوم معنی دى واضح کونکی، حقایق ښکاره کونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: مبید نوم د عربی ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې معنی یې دى واضح کونکی یا حقایق ښکاره کونکی. دا نوم د الله تعالیٰ د اسماء الحسنیٰ څخه یو دی، چې په اسلامي کلیتور کې ډیر اهمیت لري. په افغانستان او پاکستان کې د پښتو ژبې د ګویو په منځ کې دى نوم کارول شوی دی.

in_english.name: Mubid
in_english.meaning: Mubid is a beautiful name meaning clarifier, revealer of facts
in_english.long_meaning: Mubid is derived from Arabic roots, signifying one who clarifies or reveals facts. It is one of Allah's beautiful names (Asma'ul-Husna) in Islam, emphasizing the attribute of revealing truth and exposing falsehood. The name holds significant spiritual and cultural value in Islamic tradition, symbolizing guidance and enlightenment. It is used across various Muslim cultures as a given name for its noble meaning and religious connotations.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mubid holds significant cultural significance in Islamic communities, as it is a reminder of the importance of being a positive influence and guide for others. The name is often given to individuals who are deemed to be natural leaders, or those who show great potential in leading and guiding their communities towards a more virtuous and righteous path. As such, the name Mubid is closely tied to notions of leadership, guidance, and community support.
data.spiritual_significance: Beyond its cultural significance, the name Mubid also carries a deep spiritual significance. In Islamic traditions, the guide or the leader is seen as a means through which one can draw closer to Allah. The Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) says, "A man will be a things that his last adviser (mubdi) makes him." This hadith underscores the importance of having good spiritual guides and mentors who can help us navigate the challenges of life and stay on the path of righteousness. By being a guide or a spiritual leader oneself, one can fulfill an essential role in helping others to draw closer to Allah and lead fulfilling and meaningful lives.
